description: Last week, I filed a bill to prohibit legislators from raising campaign funds on the eve of a special session. It’s a loophole that should be closed. Today the Walla Walla Union-Bulletin published an editorial agreeing with me: State lawmakers returned to Olympia last week for a special session — some of them with their … Continued

title: Editorial: Lawmakers should ban campaign fundraising prior to special sessions - Re-Elect Drew Stokesbary
